g.text: Every hop between agents, models, and tools can fail, and a naive retry books the flight twice.
From the client, three failures look the same:
· the reply is lost, but the work is done
Fix: keep the timeout and the retry, and make the
receiver idempotent: twice has the same effect as once.
(1) asking again reruns the model: FL207
(3) the timeout is read as "not done"
Fix: decide once, retry only the tool call,
